subject: SummitWorks AI Summit — sponsor benefits, logo placement & speaker slot clarification
messages:
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@summitworks.co>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.park@pr-agency.com>, contracts@summitworks.co
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Revised sponsor package + draft deliverables

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick call yesterday. Attached is our updated sponsorship kit (v3) and a draft invoice. Highlights: 1) breakout session (20 mins) + 1x panel slot, 2) tier-2 logo placement on main stage backwall and session slides, 3) 10x lead-scans provided post-show.

Couple of items we flagged as optional add-ons: category exclusivity (AI vendors) and a pre-event promoted social post ($1,200). Payment terms are net 30; DocuSign link for signature is below in the SOW.

Attachments: [attachment: SummitWorks_Sponsor_Pkg_v3.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: Invoice_RW-2026-SUMM-014.pdf (pdf)]

Can you confirm the assets deadline for logos and whether you need a longer speaking slot?

Cheers,
Ethan Brooks
Partnerships Director, SummitWorks Events

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@summitworks.co>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised sponsor package + draft deliverables

Ethan —

Thanks for the update and the PDF. A few clarifying asks from our side before we sign: 

- Speaking slot: can we convert the breakout + 1x panel into a single 30-minute moderated panel slot (we'd like a 20-min discussion + 10-min audience Q&A); this aligns better with product roadmap windows and travel schedules.
- Exclusivity: important for us to understand the scope — "AI category exclusivity" needs to clarify whether it applies to exhibitors, sponsors, or both and for which footprint (main stage only, or entire expo).
- Logo placement: tier-2 on backwall is okay, but we need front-of-stage logo inclusion (desktop-width logo on slide template) and a logo in the mobile app session card. Can you confirm both are doable?
- Lead retrieval: 10x scans feels low for the expected audience mix. Can SummitWorks either (a) increase to 20 qualified scans or (b) provide raw lead export (CSV) plus opt-in timestamps?

Operational: please send an updated SOW that reflects the panel format, the logo placements above, and any exclusivity language. Also add an asset deadline (we typically need final logos + speaker bios 21 days prior).

We’re open to exclusivity for an add-on but would like to review a final price that includes lead retrieval upgrade and the slide/app logo placements. If you can send an updated SOW + invoice, we’ll route for internal approval faster.

Thanks — I’ll loop Laura for logistics execution.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Events & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[attachment: RW_Sponsor_Assets_guide.pdf (stub)]
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@summitworks.co>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.park@pr-agency.com>, contracts@summitworks.co
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised sponsor package + draft deliverables

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

- Panel format: yes, we can convert to a single 30-minute moderated panel. We'll allocate a 30-min room and mark it as a featured AI panel.
- Exclusivity: we can offer "category exclusivity" that covers sponsored activations and exhibitor space within the AI vendor category (not entire expo). Price for that add-on would be $8,000.
- Logo placement: front-of-stage slide logo and session card in the app are doable; assets due 21 days prior as you requested (deadline: Aug 10).
- Lead retrieval: we can upgrade to 20 qualified scans + raw CSV export including opt-in timestamps (no extra fee if you sign by Aug 5).

I've attached an updated SOW (v2) reflecting the panel slot and logo specifics, plus a revised invoice showing the exclusivity add-on line. DocuSign link included for ease.

Attachments: [attachment: RW_SOW_SummitWorks_v2.docx (docx)], [attachment: Invoice_RW-2026-SUMM-014.pdf (pdf)]

If you confirm the exclusivity and sign by Aug 5 we can guarantee the app placement and bump your session to a featured timeslot.

Best,
Ethan
Partnerships Director, SummitWorks Events
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@summitworks.co>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised sponsor package + draft deliverables

Ethan —

Quick logistics notes from our side: 

- The exclusivity add-on is something we need pricing flexibility on. $8k is reasonable but can you confirm whether any media partners or content sponsors are excluded from that category (we want to avoid surprise competitors in the session page).
- Please confirm booth location: a corner spot near the demo lounge would be ideal. Can you tentatively reserve Booth C12?
- AV/tech: we'll bring one laptop and will need a direct HDMI run + 2 wired mics and a moderator lavalier. Please confirm available on-site AV support.

Also: can we get one promotional tweet from the SummitWorks handle and one on-site mention from the emcee included in the base package (you previously mentioned social promotion but it wasn't explicit).

If you can update the SOW to reflect the above (featured timeslot, Booth C12 reserve, AV specs, emcee mention, and app/session-card logo), we can escalate to finance for the exclusivity approval.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@summitworks.co>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Subject: Final SOW + DocuSign link — SummitWorks AI Summit

Hi team —

Thanks for the quick replies and the practical asks. Per your direction we've: 
- Converted your session to a featured 30-min moderated panel (20+10)
- Reserved a provisional Booth C12 near the demo lounge (final allocation after payment)
- Included front-of-stage slide logo + app session card logo; assets due Aug 10
- Upgraded lead retrieval to 20 qualified scans + raw CSV with opt-in timestamps (no additional fee if signed by Aug 5)
- Added emcee mention + one promoted tweet from SummitWorks handle in the base package
- Added category exclusivity as an optional line item ($8,000) — detailed scope in SOW section 4.2

Attached: final SOW (RW_SOW_SummitWorks_v2.docx) and updated invoice. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-efgh

Please review and sign by Aug 5 to lock placements and the no-fee lead upgrade. If you want me to route a version with a reduced exclusivity fee for internal review, I can put that on the table but will need to check with my director.

Appreciate the keep moving — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to run through the SOW.

Best,
Ethan Brooks
Partnerships Director, SummitWorks Events
